taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: 59.3 m to depth (unconstrained/semi-infinite layer, low resistivity 178 ohm-m)
Recommendation: The target aquifer corresponds to the low-resistivity (178 ohm-m) layer beginning at 59.3 m depth; drilling should proceed to at least 70–80 m to adequately penetrate this saturated zone, with casing set through the overlying resistive layers (particularly the 3706 ohm-m unit from 27.1–59.3 m) to prevent collapse and ensure a clean screen interval within the aquifer.
